notes: Abstract was fenced and was not used. Table 2 was legible and the two data columns were confirmed as HSA-dTMP then dTMP-HSA because the t1/2 row (17.1, 16.1) matches the Results prose exactly. Full Table 2 values: t1/2 17.1 vs 16.1 h; CL1/F 4559 vs 4387 l/h/kg; AUC(0-inf) 25,699 vs 35,018 h*ng/ml; V1/F 106,186 vs 102,078 l/kg; Tmax 2.32 vs 2.39 h. NOTE that the reported clearance and volume of distribution are physically implausible for a mouse (thousands of l/h/kg, hundred thousand l/kg) and almost certainly carry a unit or scaling error in the source; they are recorded verbatim as printed and are not used to derive anything. NO Cmax is reported - Table 2 lists only t1/2, CL1/F, AUC(0-inf), V1/F and Tmax, and the Results prose adds nothing further, so cmax is "not reported" for both fusion proteins even though tmax is given. NO absorption half-life and no absorption rate constant (Ka) are reported, despite an extravascular one-compartment fit that would normally yield one; nothing was converted or inferred. half_life_phase is "unspecified" because the paper defines the parameter only as "t1/2, half-life in serum" and never names an elimination, distribution or terminal phase. The Results text says "in plasma" in one sentence while the Methods, Table 2 footnote and Fig. 8 caption all say serum; serum is recorded as the matrix. The statement in the Discussion that the fusion half-life is "about 15-fold higher than that of dTMP" rests on a literature value for dTMP (approximately 1 h, cited to de Serres et al. 1999 in the Introduction); dTMP itself was NOT dosed in this study, so no half-life is recorded for it and it is not listed as an agent. The Ethical approval statement mentions procedures on "mice and rabbits", and an anti-TMP rabbit polyclonal antibody was prepared in-house, but no rabbit experiment is described in the body, so rabbit is not listed as a dosed species. The signal peptide MKWVTFISLLFLFSSAYSRGVFRR is explicitly identified in the body as HSA's natural secretion signal and is therefore cleaved from the mature secreted protein; it is reported here as part of the expressed precursor only.
